We need to determine number of methyl groups in the sample's molecule. We have no description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see signals for CH3 (singlet, doublet, etc). Could also use carbon NMR to see CH3 carbon signals (~10-30 ppm). We need to count methyl groups.

We need to run proton NMR. Use tool proton_nmr_spectra (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string, but we have no SMILES. The tool signature: proton_nmr_spectra = (_: {}) => any. No parameters. So it will return spectra for the sample at hand (the unknown). Let's call it.
